title: Installers (productivity)
note: The installers the productivity bakes used, a folder per product: floppies as Disk Copy images, installer folders from CDs. Installed elsewhere too: AppleWorks, ClarisWorks, WordPerfect, Excel, Office 98, GraphicConverter, Acrobat Reader. Only here (installing takes the product's serial number): Photoshop 4.0, Illustrator 6.0, PageMaker 6.5, FreeHand 8, the QuarkXPress 4.0 upgrade, Persuasion 3.0, FileMaker Pro 4.0, and Word 5.1a (its bake doesn't get through it yet).
